godot_forward: +Z in the file (cab at +Z); the visual definition turns it 180 degrees to -Z
collision_recommendation: Use simple BoxShape3D/CapsuleShape3D or custom RTS footprint data; do not use render mesh collision per unit.
source_pipeline: Sketchfab glTF-binary download (1k textures, 449.9k triangles) reduced with glTF-Transform and meshoptimizer: sloppy simplification to ~17k triangles, textures resized to 256 px WebP, origin moved to bottom centre. Credit in godot/project/credits.json.
